tracks.title: ซ้อมมวยหลังเลิกงาน (After-Work Muay Thai)
tracks.subject: office workers in an after-work Muay Thai fitness class (a workout, not a fight), the trainer shouting for twenty more kicks while the accountant and the IT guy collapse on the mat, and everyone limping to work the next morning

tracks.title: ต้อนเป็ดข้ามถนน (Ducks Across the Road)
tracks.subject: a boy herding his family's two hundred ducks across a provincial highway at dusk with a bamboo pole and a red bag, while a ten-wheel truck and a pickup wait, and counting them all again on the far bank

tracks.title: รอน้ำพร้อม (Waiting for the Water)
tracks.subject: a couple who set up their first fish tank in a Nonthaburi condo and must wait six weeks for the water to cycle before buying a single betta, testing the water strip together every night

tracks.title: หมีตัวโตขึ้นวิน (Big Bear on the Bike Taxi)
tracks.subject: a woman who wins a giant pink teddy bear at a temple-fair ring toss and has to ride home on a motorcycle taxi with the bear squeezed between her and the driver, its ears covering his eyes

tracks.title: จีบนิ้วหน้ากระจก (Jeeb in the Mirror)
tracks.subject: a schoolgirl practising Thai classical dance hand curves (jeeb) in the wardrobe mirror every night for her school's Wai Khru day, her little brother copying her from the doorway with tangled fingers

tracks.title: ตำนี้ใครกินไหว (Who Can Eat This Somtam)
tracks.mood: rowdy, sweaty and laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a Bangkok office's Friday pot-luck where Pae from purchasing brings a somtam made with thirty bird's-eye chillies; one bite each sends the whole 14th floor queueing at the water cooler, while the narrator calmly keeps eating and becomes the only person Pae will pound it for

tracks.title: ไพ่ตองของยาย (Grandma's Tong Cards)
tracks.subject: a man spending his first Songkran at his girlfriend's family home learning her grandmother's tong card game to win the family over, losing every hand for three days, until the grandmother deals to him first and calls him หลาน

tracks.title: อ่านได้หมด (I Can Read Them All)
tracks.subject: a Roi Et rice farmer on his first trip abroad, a temple tour bus to Vientiane his daughter paid for, who bets the Lao driver a crate of Beerlao that he can read every Lao shop sign because it is nearly Isan, and loses to a French bakery sign and the railway station sign he reads as a discount on lights

tracks.title: สูบน้ำคืนเดือนสาม (Pumping Water in the Third Month)
tracks.subject: a young man running the diesel pump every dry-season night onto his family's shallot beds on the Chi river bank in Maha Sarakham, and the young woman who runs the pump on the next plot; they talk across the ditch over the engine noise until he offers to carry her pipe

tracks.title: บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า (Wild Blueberries)
tracks.mood: tired, wry and homesick but grinning
tracks.subject: a Chaiyaphum man on his third summer picking wild blueberries in the forests of Finnish Lapland, counting buckets at the scale each evening, cooking sticky rice in a borrowed school kitchen, and noticing the August sun is still up at eleven at night

tracks.title: ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว (Here Comes the New Sign)
tracks.subject: the megaphone woman on a Bang Phlat district-office crew swapping the faded blue street-name signs down one soi in a single afternoon, announcing every stop through a megaphone while the aunties argue the new sign is spelled wrong, a noodle shop owner protests the two thousand business cards he printed with the old soi number, and kids pose for photos under each sign before the paint is dry

tracks.title: เลื่อยน้ำแข็ง (Ice Saw)
tracks.subject: a night-shift worker at a Bangkok ice plant during a 43-degree April heatwave, hauling 150-kilo blocks out of the brine tanks, sawing them into quarters and loading ten trucks before dawn, the only cold man in the city

tracks.title: จิ้งหรีดไม่ยอมร้อง (Silent Crickets)
tracks.subject: a cricket farmer outside Khon Kaen whose forty concrete rings of crickets chirp all night every night, until the man from a Bangkok protein-snack company comes to inspect and every ring goes silent, until her husband plays his electric phin and they start up again

tracks.title: มุมขวาล่าง (Bottom Right Corner)
tracks.subject: a deaf sign-language teacher in Chiang Mai who watches her husband, a former student from her Saturday class at the public library, interpret the northern regional evening news in the small box in the bottom-right corner of the screen; at the end of every bulletin he touches his collar twice, their sign that he is coming home

tracks.title: ซี่ลวดสามสิบหกซี่ (Thirty-Six Spokes)
tracks.genre: J-pop piano band rock (sung in Thai)
tracks.subject: a 19-year-old apprentice at an old Bangkok bicycle-repair shop rebuilding her first customer's rusted delivery bike spoke by spoke, watched by the shop owner, before the rider comes back to collect it at six

tracks.title: ฉายให้เธอคนเดียว (A Show for One)
tracks.subject: a husband and wife who have run the last single-screen cinema in Lampang for forty years, he threading the 35mm projectors upstairs and she selling tickets downstairs; on closing night he borrows a print of the film that was showing the night he first saw her from the Thai Film Archive and screens it for her alone in row F, deliberately missing the last reel changeover as he did in 1985 when he was watching her instead of the cue marks

tracks.title: ไดโนเสาร์คอยาว (The Long-Neck Dinosaur)
tracks.subject: a kindergarten class trip to the Sirindhorn Dinosaur Museum in Kalasin, where the children count the neck vertebrae of the long-neck sauropod skeleton out loud and keep losing count, a boy named Ton Kla insists a fossil egg in the glass case is his and wants to take it home to hatch, and the teacher hides behind the T-rex model and roars

tracks.title: ลงตมนำกัน (Mud For Two)
tracks.subject: the builder on his village's team at the Yasothon rocket festival, whose bamboo rocket hisses and sits on the launch ramp, and the girl from the rival team who claims the right to throw him into the mud pit herself, then jumps in after him before her own team's rocket is lit

tracks.title: สามหมื่นเมตร (Thirty Thousand Metres)
tracks.subject: a Mathayom 5 girl in a provincial school science club who spent a year's lunch money on a weather balloon carrying a small camera, sitting on the school football field the night before the launch and wanting to see her own town from thirty kilometres up

tracks.title: เทริดคือหมวกกันน็อก (My Crown's My Helmet)
tracks.subject: a Nora dancer hired by the provincial transport office to perform helmet verses at Phatthalung schools, who tells six hundred students his beaded crown is his helmet, then sees the headmaster ride off bareheaded and improvises a verse about him over the school loudspeakers

tracks.title: ทุเรียนเต้นได้ (Dancing Durian)
tracks.mood: sweaty, giddy and proud of it
tracks.subject: a woman inside a giant durian mascot suit dancing the shows every two hours at a shopping mall's durian fair, seeing the crowd only through the mesh mouth

tracks.title: เสือขยิบตา (The Tiger Winked)
tracks.subject: a Mathayom 4 boy in the school sports-day card-stunt stand who flips to the wrong page and puts a white dot in the giant tiger's eye in front of the whole school

tracks.title: หมาจำผมได้ (The Dogs Know Me)
tracks.subject: a parcel courier on a Pak Kret housing-estate route who knows every dog on it by name, and the old brown dog that guards a parcel for him when nobody is home

tracks.title: สองแปดเจ็ด (Two-Eight-Seven)
tracks.subject: a father who vowed a kae-bon likay show to the village shrine if his son passed the police-cadet exam, sitting in the front row in a pressed white shirt while the likay prince weaves the son's name and his score of 287 into the plot

tracks.title: ฉาบคู่นี้ (These Cymbals)
tracks.subject: the cymbal player in a hired long-drum troupe who has played behind the same woman dancing at the head of every merit procession for six years, and this kathin hands his cymbals to the new boy and walks up front to dance beside her

tracks.title: หวานยี่สิบห้า (25% Sweet)
tracks.subject: the office junior who takes the bubble-tea order for the whole floor in the group chat and gets every sweetness level wrong

tracks.title: ขบวนสุดท้าย (Last Train)
tracks.subject: running for the last BTS train at midnight with your heels in your hand after a friend's birthday dinner

tracks.title: ชั่วโมงละสามร้อย (300 An Hour)
tracks.subject: two friends renting a rehearsal room by the hour in Saphan Khwai and racing the wall clock to finish one song before the owner knocks

tracks.title: ตัวเงินตัวทอง (Lumpini Lizard)
tracks.subject: an office worker who eats lunch on the same Lumpini Park bench every day beside a monitor lizard he has named after his boss

tracks.title: พริกเม็ดแรก (First Chili)
tracks.subject: a couple growing chilli and holy basil in paint buckets on their condo balcony and waking early to check whether the first chilli has turned red

tracks.title: มุ้งหลังแรก
tracks.subject: a young couple hanging a mosquito net in their first rented room, arguing over which corner goes where, then lying under it listening to the rain

tracks.title: ลดอีกสิบบาท
tracks.subject: two strangers selling T-shirts at neighbouring stalls at Chatuchak weekend market who undercut each other by ten baht all Saturday, then split one plate of pad thai at closing

tracks.title: แหล่ปลดหนี้กระบะ
tracks.subject: a pickup driver paying the last of seventy-two monthly instalments and announcing it to the whole village in a lae

tracks.title: ไม้กวาดตีสี่
tracks.subject: a city street sweeper in an orange vest on her four a.m. shift on Sukhumvit, sweeping past clubbers spilling out and moving to the bass that leaks from the doors

tracks.title: ลุงจูนเสา
tracks.subject: an uncle on the soi who climbs every neighbour's roof to fix their TV antenna and shouts down asking whether the picture is back

tracks.title: หมวกใบที่สอง (The Second Helmet)
tracks.genre: Central Thai luk thung ballad (Suphan Buri style)
tracks.subject: keeping a boyfriend's helmet hooked on the scooter in Suphan Buri for the two years he works in a Korean factory

tracks.title: ที่นอนยังอุ่น (Still Warm)
tracks.mood: sleepy, devoted and still smitten at seven in the morning
tracks.subject: a young married couple on opposite shifts sharing one rented room in Bang Na, she home from a bakery night shift at half past six, he leaving for a building site at seven, and the half hour at the door that is their whole day together

tracks.title: ผีสวนยาง (Rubber Grove Ghost)
tracks.genre: Southern Thai string sator luk thung
tracks.subject: a rubber tapper at two in the morning sure a ghost is knocking over his latex cups, until his head torch finds the neighbour's goat

tracks.title: ฝั่งนี้ (This Side)
tracks.genre: ramwong yon yuk temple-fair circle dance
tracks.subject: a ramwong band at a temple fair trying to win the crowd back from the likay stage across the yard, until the likay hero comes over after his show, still in make-up, and buys a coupon

tracks.title: วิทยุเสีย (Radio's Broken)
tracks.subject: driving from Bangkok to Hua Hin on a Friday night in a car with a dead radio, the two of you singing every song yourselves and missing the high notes

tracks.title: รถเกี่ยวคันแดง (Red Harvester)
tracks.subject: the only woman in a Surin district who drives a combine harvester, and the men who said she couldn't now queueing to book her first

tracks.title: ตัวสำรอง (The Sub)
tracks.subject: a school troupe's drum carrier who gets to play lead pong lang at the Kalasin festival because the regular player broke his arm falling out of a mango tree

tracks.title: ผิงไฟเช้าแรก (First Cold Morning)
tracks.subject: the first cold morning of the year in a Lampang lane, when the neighbours light a fire of dry leaves in a yard and an old man brings out his sueng

tracks.title: สายแปด (Bus 8)
tracks.subject: a number 8 bus splashing your only ironed white shirt on the way to a job interview, and the interviewer's first question

tracks.title: เจ็ดเสียง (Seven Tones)
tracks.subject: re-tuning a second-hand ranat ek bought online at midnight, adding and scraping the wax-and-lead lumps under its twenty-one bars by ear, because the phone tuner only knows twelve notes and the Thai scale has seven equal steps

tracks.title: เซ็นตรงนี้ (Initial Here)
tracks.mood: quietly scared and sure, one page at a time
tracks.subject: a couple initialling all forty pages of their first condo loan at a Saturday bank branch while the officer reads each clause and both do the thirty-year sums in silence

tracks.title: ส่องกบ (Frog Night)
tracks.mood: muddy, warm and laughing, one weekend long
tracks.subject: a rainy-season night catching frogs in the paddy by headlamp with old schoolfriends home from Bangkok for one weekend, then grilling the catch at a field hut at midnight

tracks.title: หอกระจายข่าว (Village Speaker)
tracks.genre: Isan luk thung hook x hip-hop crossover
tracks.subject: a young man inventing lost-property reports so the girl who reads the village loudspeaker announcements will say his name

tracks.title: 25 องศา (Room Temp)
tracks.subject: a couple's nightly fight over the air-conditioner remote that always ends at twenty-five degrees

tracks.title: ผ้าเช็ดตัวผืนเดียว (One Towel)
tracks.subject: a condo management notice fining you five hundred baht for one towel drying on the balcony

tracks.title: ลุงชิตถูกหวย (Uncle Chit Won)
tracks.mood: rowdy, broke and very happy about it
tracks.subject: a neighbour who wins two thousand baht on the lottery and hires a five-thousand-baht brass band to parade it round the soi

tracks.title: นกหวีดเรือด่วน (Boat Whistle)
tracks.mood: unhurried and proud of a small skill
tracks.subject: a Chao Phraya express boat deckhand who has brought the boat into every pier with a whistle for fifteen years

tracks.title: หมูกระทะวันจันทร์ (Monday Diet)
tracks.subject: starting a diet every Monday morning and abandoning it at the Monday-night moo kratha grill

tracks.title: ประตูเงินประตูทอง (Silver Gate, Gold Gate)
tracks.subject: the bride's cousins and the groom's friends bargaining in rhyme at the silver and gold door-gates of a Thai wedding

tracks.title: ถือสายไว้ก่อน (Keep Him Talking)
tracks.subject: keeping a call-centre scammer pretending to be the police on the line for forty minutes at one in the morning

tracks.title: งานบวชลูกชาย
tracks.mood: a merit everyone praises and one mother counts in months
tracks.subject: walking behind your son three times round the temple before his ordination

tracks.title: งานวัดตอนกลางคืน
tracks.mood: the best aunt in the world for one night
tracks.subject: twenty shots at a temple-fair stall to win a niece a keychain bear

tracks.title: นาหลังเกี่ยว
tracks.subject: sitting on the paddy dyke beside your father for an hour after harvest

tracks.title: แม่ค้าส้มตำ
tracks.mood: a street that only notices its song when it stops
tracks.subject: a papaya salad vendor who sings molam while pounding, and the evening she doesn't

tracks.title: โทรศัพท์บ้าน
tracks.mood: the one thing a fading memory still keeps
tracks.subject: a cream-coloured landline a mother still pays for because a father in care calls it every Sunday

tracks.title: ตู้เย็นเสียงดัง
tracks.mood: waiting for a sound is worse than the sound
tracks.subject: a refrigerator that only rattles sometimes, and a mother who pays for the repair

tracks.title: ใส่บาตร
tracks.mood: understanding a ritual ten years too late
tracks.subject: a grandmother who cooked fresh rice at five every morning for the alms bowl

tracks.title: รถติดบนทางด่วน
tracks.subject: forty minutes stopped on an expressway, and the phone call it bought you

tracks.title: ร้านซักผ้าหยอดเหรียญ
tracks.genre: Thai luk krung retro big band
tracks.mood: three strangers with nothing to be
tracks.subject: a coin laundry at half past ten and a man who folds very slowly

tracks.title: ครูสอนพิเศษ
tracks.mood: gratitude that arrives after the person leaves
tracks.subject: a twenty-three-year-old tutor who explains the same thing four times

tracks.title: ครั้งสุดท้ายที่พาไป (Last Ride)
tracks.genre: Thai synth-pop with guest rap verse
tracks.subject: driving a twelve-year-old dog to the vet for the last time

tracks.title: ตัดเองก็ได้ (Two In The Morning)
tracks.mood: bright on the surface, defiant underneath
tracks.subject: cutting your own hair at two in the morning with paper scissors

tracks.title: คืนก่อนแต่ง (One More Hour)
tracks.subject: the night before a friend's wedding, five men and an uneven table

tracks.title: จุดสีฟ้า (Find My)
tracks.subject: watching the blue dot of your stolen phone walk into a lane you have never been down

tracks.title: เก้าอี้พลาสติกซ้อนกัน
tracks.genre: luk thung with khaen and phin
tracks.subject: stacking the rented plastic chairs after everyone has left the funeral meal

tracks.title: กลัวว่าจะไม่เศร้า
tracks.mood: ชาแบบที่กลัวตัวเอง
tracks.subject: กลัวว่าวันหนึ่งจะไม่รู้สึกอะไรอีก

tracks.title: ผู้ชายร้องไห้ได้
tracks.mood: ปลดล็อกแบบเงียบ ๆ
tracks.subject: ร้องไห้ครั้งแรกตั้งแต่เด็ก

tracks.title: ออกจากซอย
tracks.mood: มั่นแบบไม่ต้องอวด
tracks.subject: คนที่ออกจากซอยไปได้

tracks.title: ส่งเงินกลับบ้าน
tracks.mood: สนุกบนความหนัก
tracks.subject: ทำงานกรุงเทพส่งเงินกลับอีสาน

tracks.title: นาฬิกาที่หยุดเดิน
tracks.mood: นิ่งจนไม่รู้ว่าผ่านไปนานแค่ไหน
tracks.subject: นาฬิกาแขวนที่หยุดไว้ตอนหกโมงยี่สิบ

tracks.title: บลูแห่งการรอคอย
tracks.persona: a producer-vocalist working alone in a bedroom studio
tracks.subject: swimming at night
